ca_app_control_policies_summary: The policy 'BYOD-Session-Controls' applies session controls to 'Office 365 Exchange Online, Office 365 SharePoint Online' for the 'All Users' population.
non_browser_block_policy_summary: The policy 'Block-Native-Clients-BYOD' requires compliant or hybrid-joined devices for client app types 'mobileAppsAndDesktopClients' and 'exchangeActiveSync'.
dlp_policies_summary: Policies 'CUI-Egress-Block-Email', 'CUI-Egress-Block-SharePoint' cover 'Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams' with action 'block and notify'.
sensitivity_labels_summary: Label 'CUI-Restricted' applies encryption with rights restricted to 'internal users only' and is auto-applied based on 'U.S. SSN, ITAR-controlled technical data'.
